mostWorthwhile.text: Fitting the exterior stop button was the most worthwhile step: it connected the build to the practical need to reach the power cut.

leastWorthwhile.text: Preparing the fins and fitting them felt routine; neither result explained whether they move or serve another function.

surprise.text: Nothing particularly surprised me in this chapter; the offered combinations and results were mostly predictable.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, though the fins' role remained unclear beyond making the whale look complete.

continue.text: I probably would not continue personally: the accessible stop is a satisfying practical detail, but most of this chapter was a sequence of predictable fittings with little explanation.
